description: This file defines classes, functions, and decorators related to error handling in PyTorch's distributed elastic training framework, including error categorization, error propagation, and error recording mechanisms.

classes.name: ProcessFailure
classes.description: Represents a failed process, capturing error details, timestamp, and error message, typically read from an error file generated during worker failure.

classes.name: ChildFailedError
classes.description: Custom exception used to propagate root failures from child processes, including detailed failure information and formatted failure reports.

methods.name: get_first_failure
methods.description: Returns the earliest failure based on timestamp among the failures.

methods.name: format_msg
methods.description: Formats the failure information into a detailed message string.

methods.name: _format_failure
methods.description: Formats individual failure details into a string for reporting.

methods.name: signal_name
methods.description: Returns the signal name if the process was terminated by a signal.

methods.name: timestamp_isoformat
methods.description: Returns the failure timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Decorator to record exceptions in the decorated function, utilizing an error handler for error propagation and logging.
